Streaming chat completion via the Google Vertex AI provider using the vertex_ai/ prefix — verifies SSE chunks from the Gemini streaming endpoint are yielded and assembled correctly

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"max_tokens\":32,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count to three, one word per response.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"vertex_ai/gemini-2.0-flash\",\"stream\":true}")
    result = client.chat_stream(request)
    chunks = []
    async for chunk in result:
        chunks.append(chunk)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
